A voice memo of mine on 13 October 2026, written by this site's agent in the voice of this site, and the first article written and published from the newsroom's own repository. The argument and the editorial responsibility are mine. The subscriptions site still gives spring 2027 for the UK rules; the date here, January 2027, is from the government's announcement of 9 August 2026. The principle, the register rules and the right-of-access rule are from [subscriptions.sgit.ai](https://subscriptions.sgit.ai/) (v0.1.0, 25 August 2026). Figures: the UK government's [consultation](https://www.gov.uk/government/consultations/consultation-on-the-implementation-of-the-new-subscription-contracts-regime) and [announcement of 9 August 2026](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/pm-starts-roll-out-of-everyday-fixes-on-the-cost-of-living-ending-rip-off-discounts-and-subscription-traps); [Citizens Advice](https://www.citizensadvice.org.uk/about-us/media-centre/press-releases/consumers-spend-688-million-on-unused-subscriptions-in-the-last-year/), 8 March 2024. Law: [DMCC Act 2024, Part 4 Chapter 2](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2024/13/part/4/chapter/2); [Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/3134); the [ICO's guide to subject access](https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/uk-gdpr-guidance-and-resources/subject-access-requests/a-guide-to-subject-access/); [EDPB Guidelines 01/2022](https://www.edpb.europa.eu/our-work-tools/our-documents/guidelines/guidelines-012022-data-subject-rights-right-access_en); Hogan Lovells on the [EU withdrawal button](https://www.hlc.com/en/publications/eu-consumer-protection-law-update-new-mandatory-withdrawal-button-what-online-traders-need-to-know), 4 May 2026; Davis Wright Tremaine on [AB 2863](https://dwt.com/insights/2024/10/ab-2863-updates-california-automatic-renewal-law); [Custom Communications v. FTC](https://ecf.ca8.uscourts.gov/opndir/25/07/243137P.pdf), 8 July 2025; the [FTC's advance notice](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2026/03/ftc-seeks-public-comment-response-advance-notice-proposed-rulemaking-regarding-negative-option), 11 March 2026. Pause features and terms from the companies' own help pages: [Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/407), [Zoom](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0087323), [Adobe](https://helpx.adobe.com/manage-account/using/creative-cloud-subscription-terms.html).
